title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Placement Volume Factor Schedule
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier — residential placement schedule, placement volume factor.** The rated amount of a new placement is multiplied by 0.95 when 12 or more certificates were issued under the program in the last 12 months, by 0.98 when 5 to 11 were, and by 1.00 when fewer than 5 were.

The count takes every issue entry of the program, on any loan, dated by its processing day within the window. A window of the last 12 months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Certificates issued under the program in the last 12 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 5 | 1.00 |
| 5 to 11 | 0.98 |
| 12 or more | 0.95 |

*Window edge (hypothetical):* with today on the 8th of a month, a certificate issued on the 8th of the same month one year earlier has completed 12 whole months and falls outside the window; one issued on the 9th of that month is still inside it.
